Package com.egradx.notification

Class EgradxNotificationAuthorities

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.EgradxNotificationAuthorities
public final class EgradxNotificationAuthorities extends Object
The authorities the admin endpoints check. With egradx-auth, egradx-notification-auth contributes them to its catalog: READ and MANAGE go to every organization's Admin role, and BROADCAST is reserved to the platform organization, as egradx.organization.* is — a tenant administrator can never grant it to themselves.
